mapper.sql: a.id, a.author_id, a.title, a.summary, a.cover_url, a.category_id, a.status, a.publish_time, a.deleted, a.create_time, a.update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM collect_record c JOIN article a ON a.id = c.article_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.status = 1 AND a.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND a.deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.update_time DESC
SELECT id, author_id, publish_time FROM article WHERE author_id = #{authorId} AND status = 'PUBLISHED' AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY publish_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM article a WHERE a.id > #{afterId} AND a.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND a.deleted = 0 ORDER BY a.id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id FROM article WHERE id > #{afterId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM article a WHERE a.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND a.deleted = 0 AND (a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY a.publish_time DESC
